title: nan
authors: Nam S.; Kim T.; Oh J.; Lee S.
key_contribution: Presents a cascade factor graph optimization (FGO) VINS algorithm using relative pose factors and GPS-availability node fixing for high-altitude UAVs during GPS outages.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Optimization_Based_VIO to ensure precise positioning.
